_readme: Empty SYNC_TOKEN is filled on first apply and printed. Empty ADMIN_USER or ADMIN_PASSWORD turns /admin off. Both can also be changed on /admin. Empty SMTP_HOST turns mail off; the report is still stored. The sending mailbox stays in this file. TZ applies on the next start. REPORT_TIME is HH:mm. REPORT_FORMAT is builtin or custom. custom reads report.txt next to this file.
